title: A Hollow for the Ember
author: Gideon Amberdale
blurb: Rafael Voss, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
